item.title: Traffic Alert: Fiery Odessa crash halts I-20 westbound traffic
item.description: ODESSA, Texas (KMID/KPEJ) - A fiery crash has caused a complete standstill on I-20 Westbound at West County Road in Odessa. Rescue services have extinguished the flames. Details are limited at the moment. We will continue to update once we gain more information.
